results.question: 查一下最近 7 天西湖区每天的清运总量
results.sql: SELECT rm.route_date, SUM(rm.total_weight) AS total_weight FROM t_route_manifest rm JOIN t_region r ON rm.region_id = r.id WHERE r.region_name = '西湖区' AND rm.route_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY rm.route_date ORDER BY rm.route_date DESC LIMIT 1000

results.question: 最近一周所有预警事件明细，按时间倒序
results.sql: SELECT a.id, a.alert_time, a.alert_type, v.plate_number, r.region_name FROM t_alert a JOIN t_vehicle v ON a.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN t_region r ON v.region_id = r.id WHERE a.alert_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY a.alert_time DESC LIMIT 1000
results.detail: 期望列全部正确，额外多给 1 列

results.question: 把浙A·12345 的清运量改成 0
浙A·12345 今天的磅单明细
results.sql: SELECT wb.id AS bill_id, v.plate_number, r.region_name, rm.route_date, wb.waste_type, wb.weight, rm.status FROM t_weigh_bill wb JOIN t_route_manifest rm ON wb.manifest_id = rm.id JOIN t_vehicle v ON rm.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN t_region r ON rm.region_id = r.id WHERE REPLACE(v.plate_number, '·', '') = '浙A12345' AND rm.route_date = CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY wb.id LIMIT 1000

results.question: 各种垃圾类型的磅单总重量
results.sql: SELECT waste_type, SUM(weight) AS total_weight, COUNT(*) AS bill_count FROM t_weigh_bill GROUP BY waste_type ORDER BY total_weight DESC LIMIT 1000
